description: Use only after review: requires a doc_id returned by propose_masking with require_human_review: true, and the user must have clicked Redact in the review GUI. Returns a temporary download_url for the finalized masked PDF, then deletes the document from the processing server. Do not call it with a guessed doc_id or before the user confirms the review is done.

doc_id.description: Document ID (doc_id) of the reviewed document.

name: fetch_reviewed_document
title: Aigine Redact – Fetch reviewed document
